playbookOutputs: CIPC CoR39 confirmation showing the director as resigned / removed
Signed resignation letter or removal resolution (client copy)
playbookCommonFailures: The director being removed is the only director — a company must keep at least one, so an Add Director must be done first or together
No signed resignation letter and no shareholder resolution, so there is no proof of the change
Certified ID of the resigning director older than 3 months or unobtainable because the director is uncooperative
Company has outstanding annual returns so CIPC blocks the CoR39
Resignation date given is before the director's appointment date on the register

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Certificate (CoR 14.3 / Disclosure Certificate)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the company CoR 14.3 registration certificate.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 or Disclosure Certificate showing enterprise registration number and current active directors.

informationToProvide.label: Director Being Removed — Full Name, ID Number, Last Known Email & Cellphone, Effective Removal Date, and Reason for Removal
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide the details of the director being removed, the effective removal date, and the statutory reason for removal under Section 71 (e.g., s71(1) shareholder removal, s71(3) board removal for ineligibility/incapacity/neglect).

informationToProvide.label: Certified SA ID Copies of All Remaining Directors & Voting Shareholders (Not Older Than 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload certified ID copies (< 3 months) for all remaining directors and the shareholders signing the Section 71 removal resolution.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Remaining Active Directors — Full Names, Email Addresses & Cellphone Numbers (for CIPC OTPs)
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide the direct email address and cellphone number for each remaining active director.

informationToProvide.label: Signed Section 71 Notice of Meeting, Statement of Reasons & Proof of Delivery to the Director Being Removed
informationToProvide.helpText: CIPC strictly requires proof that the director was given formal notice of the proposed removal and an opportunity to make representations before the vote (email delivery receipt, sheriff return, or courier proof).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Notice of shareholders/board meeting under Section 71 of the Companies Act stating the reasons for proposed removal, accompanied by proof of service/delivery (email timestamp, registered post, or courier receipt) to the affected director.

informationToProvide.label: Signed Section 71 Shareholders / Board Resolution & Meeting Minutes Removing the Director
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the signed ordinary resolution of shareholders (s71(1)) or board resolution (s71(3)) and meeting minutes confirming the removal vote.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed ordinary resolution of shareholders or board resolution and attendance/minutes under Section 71 of the Companies Act resolving to remove the named director, signed by the requisite majority.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect director IDs, resignation details and company documents
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR14.3, certified IDs of the leaving and a remaining director, resignation date and contact details received; resignation vs removal established
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ask first: is the director resigning voluntarily, or are the shareholders removing them? Voluntary needs a signed resignation letter; removal needs a shareholders' resolution and proof the director was given notice and a chance to respond (s71). Confirm the effective date. If this leaves the company with no director, say so plainly and propose Add Director together with this order. Turnaround 1-2 working days; never promise faster.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify documents and remaining-director rule
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Uploads pass; at least one director remains; company status 'In Business'
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Match the leaving director's name and ID number to the CoR14.3 record. Confirm at least one active director remains after the change. Check CIPC for outstanding annual returns and propose that service first if any. Resignation date must be on or after the appointment date on the register.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft resignation letter / removal resolution and CoR39 handoff sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Resignation letter (voluntary) or shareholder resolution (removal), board resolution noting the change, and handoff sheet drafted
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Resignation letter: addressed to the board, states the director resigns with effect from the confirmed date, signed by the leaving director. Removal: shareholders' resolution under s71 recording the ordinary resolution and that notice was given. Handoff sheet: company, director, ID number, status change to Resigned, effective date, reason code, contact details for notification.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send resignation letter / resolution for signature
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Signed resignation letter or resolution uploaded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain who signs what: the leaving director signs the resignation letter; a remaining director signs the board resolution; shareholders sign a removal resolution. Return as PDF. No threats.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: File CoR39 director resignation on CIPC e-Services
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Amendment staged with the director set to Resigned on the effective date and documents uploaded; Kevin has submitted; tracking number saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: CIPC e-Services > Transact > Director Amendments (CoR39). Change the director's status to Resigned (or Removed) with the effective date; do not delete the record. Upload certified IDs, the resignation letter or resolution. ⚠ verify: CIPC's current supporting-document rule for director resignations filed by third parties. Record the tracking number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for CIPC to process the change
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR39 confirmation received and the director no longer shows as active
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check tracking status before following up. On rejection quote the reason to Kevin.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver CoR39 confirmation and updated CoR14.3
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Confirmation and re-downloaded CoR14.3 posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Remind the client that shares held by the leaving director are not affected by this filing — offer the Share Certificate / Share Register and Beneficial Ownership services if ownership also changes. Also update the bank mandate and SARS representative if the leaving director held those roles.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
